profiles.title: Aspect ratio changes do not apply and virtual pad fails in landscape
symptoms: Aspect ratio option such as Stretch to Window appears to be ignored
Virtual pad stops responding after switching to landscape
iPad or iPhone landscape layout keeps the old render bounds

display.aspect_ratio: Fit to Window or 4:3 before launching a game; change again only after returning to the pause/settings overlay

input.virtual_pad_layout: Reset to default after orientation change
input.touch_hitbox_rebuild: Required whenever orientation or safe area changes

implementation_notes: When application code becomes available, recalculate the Metal drawable viewport and touch hitboxes inside the same orientation-change transaction.
Persist aspect-ratio selection separately from the render surface size so UI changes invalidate cached viewport state.
user_steps: Force-close the app after changing aspect ratio once.
Lock the device in landscape, reopen the app, then launch the game.
If the virtual pad still misses touches, reset the controller layout and avoid changing orientation while a game is running.

profiles.title: EE Core JIT instability while Interpreter is stable but slow
symptoms: Game works correctly with EE Interpreter but has low FPS
JIT mode introduces freezes, timing bugs, or broken game logic

cpu.ee_core: Interpreter for affected scenes; JIT for normal gameplay after saving
cpu.vu0: Interpreter when geometry or animation is unstable
cpu.vu1: Interpreter for animation/geometry bugs; re-enable recompiler only after testing

implementation_notes: Gate JIT behind a per-title compatibility flag until block invalidation and self-modifying-code paths are audited.
Add a quick-toggle action for EE Interpreter/JIT so users can pass unstable scenes without restarting.
user_steps: Switch EE Core to Interpreter and set speedhacks to Safe.
Pass the unstable scene, save again, then test JIT only after the scene has completed.

profiles.title: Need for Speed series missing audio and Carbon loading freezes
symptoms: Gameplay runs but music/effects are silent
Need for Speed Carbon freezes on loading screens

cpu.ee_core: Interpreter for loading transitions if JIT freezes

implementation_notes: Prioritize SPU2 DMA/ADMA timing and IOP/CDVD synchronization for EA titles.
Avoid Fast CDVD defaults for stream-heavy racing games because loading screens can wait forever for media/audio events.
user_steps: Disable Fast CDVD and restart the game from a clean boot.
Set audio synchronization to TimeStretch or Sync and increase output latency to 100 ms.
For Carbon loading freezes, temporarily switch EE Core to Interpreter before loading the next race/menu.

profiles.title: Midnight Club 3 Remix infinite loading entering garage
symptoms: Career mode cannot progress into garage
Issue reproduces with Metal renderer, native resolution, default speedhacks, and Fast CDVD disabled

settings.save_strategy: Use an in-game save immediately before entering the garage; avoid save states made on the loading screen

implementation_notes: This looks like a streaming/timing deadlock rather than a renderer freeze; investigate CDVD, IOP, and VU timing before graphics-only changes.
Add per-game automatic safe-mode switching around known streaming transitions when runtime hooks are available.
user_steps: Boot clean, load an in-game save, and set speedhacks to Safe with MTVU off.
Switch EE Core and VU1 to Interpreter before entering the garage.
After the garage loads and an in-game save is written, re-enable faster settings one at a time.

profiles.title: God of War screen flickers when hits occur
symptoms: Screen flickers for a few seconds when Kratos or enemies are hit

renderer.hardware_fixes: Enable accurate destination alpha / framebuffer fetch when available

implementation_notes: Hit flashes exercise framebuffer feedback, destination alpha, and alpha blending; force accurate Metal render-target resolve/barrier behavior for this title.
Do not sample from a render target that is still bound for writing; resolve or use framebuffer fetch before the post-process pass.
If Metal cannot provide an accurate path yet, auto-select the slower software/accurate fallback profile for hit-flash scenes.
user_steps: Enable high/accurate blending, accurate destination alpha, and texture barrier/framebuffer effects if the UI exposes those options.
If flicker remains during hits, switch God of War to the software/most accurate renderer path until the Metal feedback path is patched.

profiles.title: Spinning models, broken geometry, and animation glitches
implementation_notes: Treat these as VU accuracy candidates; add per-title VU interpreter fallback and disable unsafe VU speedhacks by default for affected games.
Document the exact game serial/region with future reports to avoid over-broad workarounds.
user_steps: Switch VU0/VU1 to Interpreter and test the affected scene.
If fixed, re-enable one option at a time to find the minimum slowdown needed.
